name: Pepper Chicken Fettucini
description: A colorful and flavorful chicken fettucini dish with sweet peppers, mushrooms, and Parmesan cheese.
recipeIngredient: 2 sweet red peppers, cut in strips

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a pan. Add chicken, peppers, onion, mushrooms, and seasoning. Stir-fry over medium heat until chicken is cooked through.
Add hot cooked fettucini noodles and toss.
Sprinkle with Parmesan and toss. Serve hot.

_similar.name: Pesto Pasta
_similar.description: A simple and flavorful pasta dish made with pesto, sun-dried tomatoes, and Asiago cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Chop the sun-dried tomatoes and crumble or grate the Asiago cheese.
Beat together the pesto, balsamic vinegar, and oil from sun-dried tomatoes.
Add the chopped tomatoes, Asiago cheese, and pine nuts to the pesto mixture.
Toss the hot cooked pasta with the pesto mixture.
Serve with grated Parmesan cheese on top if desired.

_similar.keywords: pesto pasta, sun-dried tomatoes, Asiago cheese, Italian cuisine
